scope: World Builder worlds declare their own laws (totals and pairings) at design time; the engine refuses a step that breaks one, naming it; an independent AI review lists rule/description mismatches for the rules writer; heuristic build checks retire once covered. world-substrate only.

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: The build's heuristic checks (scripts/world_builder_service.py:840-1220) grow one per bug and raise false alarms; this replaces them in part.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: pencil13 buy-boxed-pencils pays nothing (evidence/pencil13-trace-audit/TRACE_READ.md); pencil14 failed at the installer (job f0b6d1a3dc0a40848456e6fe2ce172c0).
fact_evidence.identified_fix: Root redesign, not a single repair.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: One worktree (worktrees/ws-declared-laws) on plan/declared-laws; no other agent edits these paths.
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: One writer runs slices in sequence.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: The bundle contract gains an optional laws list; worlds without it behave as today (L7).
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: No stored-data migration; saved worlds have no laws and replay as-is.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Deploys only World Builder's own service after check_project exits 0; no outreach.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian said 'yes lets make it companhy plannign complaint' on 2026-10-28 to this design.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Five slices over more than one session.
fact_evidence.one_writer: Single implementation agent; research subagents are read-only.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: world-substrate and its deploy only; Cybernetic Influence v3 and Concordia read-only.

rationale: Re-plan after an implementation obstacle (one hand-written check per bug, pencil2-pencil14) with no single identified fix; one writer, reversible, single repository; optional contract field keeps saved worlds replay-compatible.
